issue.title: Need new test: ACL with VLAN rule Tests

failure.body:
**Description**
- [ ] VLAN ID w/ Untagged VLAN
- [ ] VLAN ID w/ Tagged VLAN
- [ ] VLAN ID where an interface is a tagged and untagged VLAN member (make sure that if we have 1 rule for the tagged VLAN and 1 rule for the untagged VLAN that the proper rule gets hit)

Note on this: You need to have routable VLANs in order for the tests to work b/c they depend on checking if packets are forwarded/dropped as expected.

Also, clarification on the 3rd test case - the idea is to check that if a given port is a member of both a tagged VLAN and an untagged VLAN, then you can send packets to it from either VLAN and the matching behavior should work.

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/3623
The idea is mainly base on this PR #3716.

This PR covers all testing scenarios in #3623

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)

### Back port request

This PR is to add test cases to verify ACL matching outer vlan id. Both ```tagged``` and ```untagged``` scenarios are covered.
